from collections import Counter, deque

def components(cells):
    cells=set(cells); out=[]
    while cells:
        c=cells.pop(); comp=[c]; q=deque([c])
        while q:
            r,cc=q.popleft()
            for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(r+dr,cc+dc)
                if n in cells: cells.remove(n); comp.append(n); q.append(n)
        out.append(comp)
    return out

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    comps={c:components([(r,i) for r in range(h) for i in range(w) if g[r][i]==c]) for c in others}
    em=[c for c in others if len(comps[c])==2][0]
    seed=[c for c in others if c!=em][0]
    seeds=[(r,i) for r in range(h) for i in range(w) if g[r][i]==seed]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    idxs=set()
    for cl in comps[em]:
        rs=[r for r,_ in cl]; cs=[c for _,c in cl]
        vert=(max(rs)-min(rs))>=(max(cs)-min(cs))
        for (r,c) in seeds:
            if vert and min(rs)<=r<=max(rs): idxs.add(r-min(rs))
            if not vert and min(cs)<=c<=max(cs): idxs.add(c-min(cs))
    for cl in comps[em]:
        rs=[r for r,_ in cl]; cs=[c for _,c in cl]
        vert=(max(rs)-min(rs))>=(max(cs)-min(cs))
        if vert:
            r0=min(rs); col=cs[0]
            d=1 if col==0 else -1 if col==w-1 else (1 if col<h/2 else -1)
            for i in idxs:
                r=r0+i
                if r>=h: continue
                c=col+d
                while 0<=c<w:
                    if g[r][c]==seed: out[r][c]=4; break
                    out[r][c]=seed; c+=d
        else:
            c0=min(cs); row=rs[0]
            d=1 if row==0 else -1 if row==h-1 else (1 if row<w/2 else -1)
            for i in idxs:
                c=c0+i
                if c>=w: continue
                r=row+d
                while 0<=r<h:
                    if g[r][c]==seed: out[r][c]=4; break
                    out[r][c]=seed; r+=d
    return out
